description: Proof-of-recall answer key for examples/weave-mini/ (corpus-weaver design spec §6, Phase W4). Ids below are PINNED — computed once via `tsx fixtures/wm-compute-answer-key.ts` from packages/candidates/ against the committed corpus + fixture-responses.ts, and asserted exactly (not by count) in packages/candidates/src/prose/__tests__/weave-mini-eval.test.ts.

entities.description: K=4 answer-key entity groups with cross-document evidence. Each entityId is stableId-minted by entityIdFor(kind, seedSurfaceForm) — order-independent (a pure function of kind + normalized surface form), so it is the same regardless of which document's mention happens to auto-cluster first.

crossDocumentExactAlias.note: Identical spelling in two documents -> auto-clusters into ONE entity (no merge proposal needed).

acronymPair.note: Different spelling in two documents -> does NOT auto-cluster (normSurface differs); MUST be proposed for merge by the band-2 acronym suggester (suggestMerges). This is the required >=1 acronym pair.

trap.description: Two DISTINCT entities sharing the exact surface form 'Interlock', one a mode (system-overview.md) and one a component (subsystem-spec.docx). MUST NOT auto-cluster (different kindHint) and MUST NOT be proposed for merge (suggestMerges requires kind-compatible endpoints).

crossDocumentLinks.description: L=3 links whose ONLY co-occurrence signal is a cross-document sectionPath prefix (cooccurKind==='section') — i.e. no single document states either endpoint's relation to the other (neither shares a chunk, since chunk ids are document-local). enumerateCooccurrence families: allocation, modeMembership.

chain.description: One valid 2-hop chain, composed from two hand-authored ALREADY-ACCEPTED relations (corpus-backed) via COMPOSITION_TABLE's allocation ∘ containment -> allocation row.
